text: {"differences":[{"evidence":"\"Bachelor's degree\" vs \"Doctoral degree\"","dimension":"formal education level","description":"This captures how advanced the applicant's academic training is relative to the role's preferred qualifications.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"3 years\" vs \"7 years\" at their prior company","dimension":"years of experience","description":"This captures the amount of professional software-engineering experience claimed in the letter.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"6 production services\" vs \"4 production services\"","dimension":"scope of production ownership","description":"This captures the amount of production software the applicant says they have tested, maintained, and launched.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"\"comfortable across 2 other languages\" vs \"5 other languages\"","dimension":"language breadth","description":"This captures how broadly the applicant claims to program across additional languages beyond Go.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"CompTIA Security+ certification\" vs \"compete hard in capture-the-flag events\"","dimension":"security signal","description":"This captures the strength of explicit security-oriented credentials or hands-on security engagement.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"Off the clock I keep a small side project going\"","dimension":"extracurricular tinkering","description":"This captures whether the letter includes personal side-project work that signals curiosity and independent building.","winner":"A"}]}
